note: RV park in Beulah run by the Beulah Convention & Visitors Bureau, on a former mobile-home park a few blocks from downtown; a key-fob comfort station with a kitchenette, TV and storm shelter. Mostly seasonal and monthly residents. --Claude
summary: CVB page + 2026 map + rules: 47 lots, every one designated year-round or seasonal (May-Oct); $45/day, $225-250/week, $625-700/month; 30/50-amp, water, sewer; comfort station; reserve by phone/form with a half deposit. '5 spots open'. Google 3.9 (23). DROP CANDIDATE: mostly seasonal/monthly AND iffy (Google under 4, eviction-style rules, residential cable/internet hookups). Price $45 passes. Not waterfront stands.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, mostly seasonal AND iffy; reviewer decides): the CVB describes '47 spacious year-round and seasonal RV sites'; the 2026 park map assigns EVERY lot (106-183) to 'SEASONAL LOT (5/1 - 10/31)' or 'YEAR AROUND LOT', several marked 'MIDCO ACCESS' / 'WRT ACCESS' (residential cable/internet providers); no lot is designated for nightly guests and the page shows '5 spots open' (i.e. 42 of 47 occupied, 2026-11-12). The rules read like a lease: 'Rent is due on the date of check in', late fees of 5-20%, 'Campsites delinquent on payment after 15 Days - The guest shall be removed from the premises and an eviction action will be pursued under N.D.C.C. § 47-16', a driver's licence number on the registration form, 'Sub Leasing is not permitted'. A $45 day rate is posted, but the nightly share is at most the ~5 open lots (~10%). Google 3.9 with 23 reviews (under 4.0; under the 25-review threshold for the automatic rule, but 'under 4 stars + borderline seasonal' applies). Nothing explicitly discourages nightly guests.
